integrity: All displayed constants are derived exactly. The included verifier uses exhaustive enumeration of all 27 ordered samples with rational arithmetic. A relevant 2021 maximal-correlation paper was only partially inspectable; that access limitation is disclosed in the review.
scientific_limitations: Counterexample only; no global optimizer over all probability vectors is claimed. The result concerns three iid draws and the extreme pair on a three-point lattice.
title: A three-draw counterexample to uniform-probability extremality for discrete order-statistic correlation
